The answer is METR. The question asks "Which nonprofit did Anthropic name on October 15, 2026 as the first team receiving employee-like access for independent frontier-model evaluation?"

The answer is METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research). The primary source is Anthropic's own blog post. I'll give a short answer with URLs.

content.text:
**METR**（Model Evaluation and Threat Research）

依据：Anthropic 官方公告 https://www.anthropic.com/news/an-update-on-independent-evaluators 及 Reuters 报道 https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/anthropic-grants-ai-evaluator-metr-employee-level-access-its-models-6463306

2026 年 10 月 15 日，Anthropic 宣布开始给予 METR（一家评估前沿 AI 模型的非营利机构）团队“employee-like access”（员工级访问权限），作为独立评估其模型、安全实践和风险管理的第一支团队。
